sections.Profile:
"Hearts Gain" is a riverboat gambling-themed electro-mechanical pinball machine released by the Spanish manufacturer Inder in 1971. The game accommodates a single player and features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, four standup targets, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Inder
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Boats, Single Player, Rivers, Gambling, Original Theme, 1970s, History
